tasks.text: Never give your password to anyone on the internet!
Protecting personal data is very important for security.
Antivirus software protects the computer from malware.
Use a strong password that contains letters and numbers!
Two-step verification provides extra protection for your account.
Think carefully before posting anything on the net!
On the internet, everyone can be who they want to seem.
Never meet strangers from the internet alone!
Backing up helps preserve your important files.
Report bullying to a trusted adult!
